niche: a regional health authority's department of public health choosing which birth cohort its one autumn 2027 MMR catch-up targets, or none, so that measles cannot keep spreading in winter 2027-28, when the cohort whose uptake fell in a 2010-12 vaccine scare is aged 15-19, and the national contact survey's public use file kept two thirds of its diaries in the school summer holidays, when teenagers' contacts with each other collapse
answer: We should fund option B, the MMR catch-up for those born 2008 to 2012: it is the only option that brings measles' reproduction number in the region below one for winter 2027-28 (0.9, against 1.3 with no catch-up).

driver: Whether a structured population can sustain a chain process through a coming season is set by the dominant eigenvalue of its who-passes-to-whom matrix under the conditions that season runs in, and the only measurement of the matrix pools observation days from two regimes, one in which the subgroup holding a large unprotected share passes mostly within itself and one, the larger share of the days, in which it does not; the pooled matrix and every textbook treatment of it put the system below its threshold, as do the system-average and contact-weighted propensities, while the matrix rebuilt from the days under the season's own regime puts it above and points at that subgroup.
driver_concrete: On 1 January 2028 the region is 95.2 per cent immune, above the 93.3 per cent measles at R0 15 needs, so R0 times the susceptible share is 0.7, and the next-generation matrix built from all 7,560 diaries of the National Social Contact Survey 2023 gives 0.9; but 5,040 of those diaries were kept from 3 July to 18 August 2023, with the schools closed, when 15 to 19-year-olds have under a fifth of their contacts with each other against more than half in the May term diaries, and the winter runs in term; built from the term-time diaries the reproduction number is 1.3, and only the catch-up for those born 2008-12, 11.2 per cent susceptible, brings it below one (0.9), while D and E, the least immune cohort and the most people made immune, leave it at 1.3.
stump: A competent solver builds the next-generation matrix from every diary in the National Social Contact Survey's public use file, scales it to R0 15 and puts measles' reproduction number at 0.9 without a catch-up, so files that no catch-up is needed; the step that lands it there is pooling the 5,040 diaries kept from 3 July to 18 August 2023, in the school summer holidays, with the 2,520 kept in May term time, when the winter's transmission runs on term-time contacts: built from the term-time diaries the reproduction number is 1.3 and only the catch-up for those born 2008-2012 brings it below one (0.9).
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every field, dose rule, profile basis and filed clause right and compares the region's 95.2 per cent immunity with the 93.3 per cent threshold (0.7), weights each band's susceptible share by its contacts (0.7), or builds the next-generation matrix from every diary in the survey, as computed, made reciprocal on either population, density-adjusted, transposed or with unknown ages spread (0.9), or with the two fieldwork periods averaged (1.0), files that no catch-up is needed; ranking cohorts by immunity gap or people made immune picks D or E, both left at 1.3.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is measles' reproduction number through winter 2027-28 under each option, which infectious-disease epidemiology computes as the dominant eigenvalue of the next-generation matrix built from the contact matrix of the transmission season and age-specific susceptibility; measles transmission is forced by the school calendar, so the winter's matrix is the term-time one. With another field's nouns there are no contact diaries, no school term and no susceptibility left by a vaccine history, so the task stops making sense.

lineage.fate: retired 2026-10-11: decisive stump was a hidden recycling term recovered from audited cells, data semantics under the client's 10/10 rules
lineage.driver: The forward draw on a book of open commitments is each unit's age rate applied to its size and capped at what remains undrawn, and what remains undrawn is restored by the proceeds of any holding sold within a fixed time of its purchase, up to the original size, a rule stated nowhere and recovered only because the certified year-end balances reproduce under plain size-minus-draws for every unit that had no quick sale and fail for the ones that did; the months since the last certified year-end carry a run of quick sales far larger than any closed year, so carrying the certified balances forward net of draws, or rebuilding them from draws alone, leaves the cap biting on units that in fact have room and under-sizes the forward draw.

lineage.driver: The forward figure is struck from whichever of several candidate pacing bases survives a walk-forward test on the closed years, with every rate re-estimated at each origin from the record before that origin and the facility sized at the plan plus the largest miss of the test; fitting once on the whole window and scoring the past with it crowns the richest base and understates the miss, so the easy validation lands two tranches short while every definition and rule in the pack is read correctly.
